Concentration ratios CR1 to CRk

Source: R/cr.R
get_cr_all.Rd

Share of a market's total resource held by its largest organizations, computed for each geography, subsector and year, with rollups for all subsectors (SUB = "ALL") and all geographies (GEO = "ALL").

Usage

get_cr_all(
  df,
  geography = "CENSUS_CBSA_FIPS",
  subsector = "NTEEV2",
  resource = "TOTREV",
  year = "TAXYEAR",
  numbers = 1:8,
  as_percent = FALSE
)

Arguments

df

A data frame with one row per organization-year.

geography

Name of the column that identifies the market's geography, such as "CENSUS_CBSA_FIPS" or "COUNTY_FIPS".

subsector

Name of the column that identifies the subsector. When it is "NTEEV2", the first three characters (the major group) are used.

resource

Name of the numeric column that measures organization size, such as "TOTREV", "TOTEXP" or "NETASS". Negative values are set to zero.

year

Name of the column that identifies the year, such as "TAXYEAR".

numbers

Integer vector of CR levels to calculate, for example c(1, 4, 8). Values above 8 produce a warning.

as_percent

If TRUE, ratios are returned on a 0-100 scale instead of 0-1.

Value

A tibble with GEO, SUB, YEAR, N, the summed resource and one column per requested ratio (CR1, CR2, ...). Markets with k or fewer organizations get CRk = 1.

Details

CRk is the sum of the resource held by the k largest organizations divided by the market total.

Examples

toy <- data.frame( GEO = "A", SUB = "ART", YEAR = 2020,
                   TOTREV = c( 50, 30, 10, 10 ) )
get_cr_all( toy, geography = "GEO", subsector = "SUB", year = "YEAR",
            numbers = 1:3 )
#> # A tibble: 4 × 8
#>   GEO   SUB    YEAR     N TOTREV   CR1   CR2   CR3
#>   <chr> <chr> <dbl> <int>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 A     ALL    2020     4    100   0.5   0.8   0.9
#> 2 A     ART    2020     4    100   0.5   0.8   0.9
#> 3 ALL   ALL    2020     4    100   0.5   0.8   0.9
#> 4 ALL   ART    2020     4    100   0.5   0.8   0.9
